TUN.note: Nothing stated about an ID authentication service.
Nothing stated about civil register and ID links.

facts.fact: The ISIE says that from 13 November 2023 voters can check their registration at voting centres and constituencies via service 195 with the national ID card number, and by SMS, with 1.406 million Tunisians having used SMS to check their polling place.

TUN.note: The 9.106m figure is registered voters, not national ID holders.
Nothing stated about numbers at birth.
Nothing stated about who runs the ID system.
Voter check by ID card number is a lookup; the document does not say the roll is keyed on or drawn from the ID register.
Nothing stated about the national ID system itself.
